title: English Practice Quiz 0266
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: We have a meeting ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with days and dates.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.
questions.explanation: Use the superlative tallest when comparing one with the whole class.

questions.question: She ___ the report before the manager arrived.
questions.explanation: Use the past perfect for an action completed before another past action.
